the use of hepatocytes from a human cell line in a bioartificial liver device is a promising approach for the treatment of patients with acute liver failure, and that the use of a human hepatocyte cell line in conjunction with a bioreactor system that mimics the hepatic microenvironment can improve the efficacy of a bioartificial device for the treatment of liver failure.
